prompt: Create a vertical monochrome black-and-white fantasy portrait of a young female knight in a refined semi-realistic anime style. Show her from the waist up in a three-quarter back pose, turning her head over her shoulder to look directly at the viewer with large expressive eyes, delicate lips, pale luminous skin, and a calm serious expression. She has jet-black hair tied in one high ponytail, with long flowing strands and wispy bangs blown by the wind. She wears exactly 5 visible armor and clothing elements: one glossy engraved breastplate, one rounded engraved shoulder pauldron with rivets, one chainmail sleeve, one dark cloak trailing behind her, and one armored glove gripping the weapon. Add exactly 1 vertical sword beside her body, with a dark wrapped grip, crossguard, and ornate pommel. The armor should be highly polished with floral filigree engravings, bright highlights, tiny specks of light, and realistic metallic reflections. Set the scene in a windswept field of soft grasses with exactly 1 blurred medieval castle on a hill in the distant background, under a cloudy bright sky. Use shallow depth of field, cinematic rim lighting from the upper right, soft atmospheric haze, drifting white particles, elegant high-detail linework, smooth grayscale gradients, dramatic contrast, and no color at all. No text, no watermark, no extra characters, no modern objects.

promptZh: 创作一张竖构图的单色黑白奇幻肖像，主角为 一位年轻女骑士，采用精致的半写实动漫风格。画面呈现她腰部以上的四分之三背影，她转头回眸，直视观众，拥有明亮动人的大眼睛、精致的嘴唇、白皙发光的皮肤以及冷静严肃的表情。她留着 乌黑 的高马尾，长发飘逸，碎发随风拂动。她身上需精确包含 5 个可见的盔甲与服饰元素：一件带有雕刻纹理的亮面胸甲、一个带有铆钉的圆形雕花肩甲、一只锁子甲袖子、一件在身后拖曳的深色斗篷，以及一只握住武器的盔甲手套。在她身侧添加 1 把垂直的长剑，剑柄缠绕深色布料，配有护手和华丽的剑首。盔甲需高度抛光，带有花卉金银丝细工雕刻、明亮的高光、细微的光点以及逼真的金属反射。场景设定在风吹拂的柔软草地上，远景山丘上设有 1 座模糊的中世纪城堡，天空明亮多云。使用浅景深、来自右上方的电影感轮廓光、柔和的大气雾气、飘浮的白色微粒、优雅的高细节线条、平滑的灰度渐变、强烈的对比度，且完全无色彩。无文字，无水印，无额外角色，无现代物品。
